Farah Diallo
farah.diallo@example.com | Providence, RI
Farah Diallo has 11 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Timberline Cloud (2022-2026), where
they owned the Java event pipeline processing 76M events/day. Before that,
Senior Backend Engineer at Nimbus Solutions (2019-2022). Before that, Backend
Engineer at Windmere Analytics (2016-2019). Before that, Software Engineer I at
Harborlight Data (2015-2016). Education: Ph.D. Software Engineering, Drexel
University, 2014; B.S. Software Engineering, Virginia Tech, 2007. Core skills:
CI/CD, Python, Distributed systems, PostgreSQL, Java, Node.js, AWS, GraphQL,
TypeScript, Go, REST API design.
